node_definition.done_when: a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner §9's done-when, as released at bd3db958d, holds. A backend may declare gate_document in flight config, and every dispatch whose resolved backend declares it reads the gate before creating a pointer or worktree, whether --local or --backend chose that backend. Each result carries lane_gate with the state the section's five-state rule names. A dispatch that waits returns ok false with error lane-paused, creates no pointer and no worktree, and the reckon crew dispatch command exits 75. The follower's review reflex, dispatch_review_for_run in reckon/crew/recovery.py, launches nothing while the gate waits, and its report row carries error lane-paused and the reason. A declared gate_document that differs from the lane document's published router_generation_gate.config_path waits, naming both paths, and a lane document that publishes no config_path or cannot be read within its own 5 s deadline records lane_gate.path_check as skipped. tests/test_dispatch_holds_while_the_lane_is_paused.py, in a temporary RECKON_HOME with a stub local backend, a temporary gate file and a stub lane document, drives every bullet of the section's done-when list and asserts lane_gate.state in each result. The declared negative control is executed and logged under pytest: with the gate check removed, the paused dispatch creates a pointer and the test fails. The _dispatch_lane_reading docstring names both facts that withhold a dispatch. The manifest names the flight-config schema file before editing it, and the generated reckon/_flight_schema.py and docs/_shared/flight.schema.json are regenerated by the generator b705f792f used. The node gate is the new test file at head, ending EXIT=0. No real gate file, lane document or scheduler is read or written. Every log sits under the run directory, headed with revision, tree and literal command, and ends EXIT=. Only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/recovery.py, reckon/cli.py (the dispatch command's exit status), reckon/schema/flight.yaml, reckon/_flight_schema.py, docs/_shared/flight.schema.json and the new test file change.
